name: Momkin
blurb: Momkin (from Arabic ممكن, "doable") helps you learn languages by visualizing what's being said.
description: Momkin (from Arabic ممكن, "doable") helps you learn languages by visualizing what's being said. All you need is some audio file that goes with a subtitle file (supported format: .srt). You can download those files with apps like NewPipe, but you can also create them yourself with programs like Aegisub.
